summary: Backend-only regression for the MLB hitter alt-lock carve-out (server.py ~1809-1834). 14/14 pytest assertions pass against the live public endpoint (https://canonical-parity.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified: (1) /api/picks/today returns 149 picks at default floor; MLB filter returns 15 picks including 3 Hits+Runs+RBIs ALT-LOCK props at lock 94.4-94.5 (Jung Hoo Lee, Luis Arraez, Gunnar Henderson — exact match to main agent's manual verification) and 12 total hitter props (Hits / H+R+RBI / TB across SF, OAK, SD, ATL, BAL — directly resolves user's 'where are the ATL/SD hitters' complaint). (2) min_lock=95 global AND is enforced across every carve-out: no sub-95 picks leak (specifically confirmed the 94.4/94.5 H+R+RBI carve-out picks disappear at min_lock=95). (3) sort=lock returns strictly DESC; default sort is 'time' (not a regression). (4) Existing carve-outs intact: tennis (sport=Tennis), soccer goal scorer (sport=Soccer), MLB pitcher K (3 found). (5) /api/picks/{id} returns 200 for 5 sampled IDs across hitter/scorer/tennis families — no 500 on alt-line picks. (6) /api/analytics/xg-form-shadow returns 200 with valid payload. (7) /api/picks/parlay (the actual parlay endpoint) returns 200 — note /api/parlay/optimize as named in the request does NOT exist (route is /api/picks/parlay). No new bugs introduced; carve-out fix verified end-to-end on the public URL.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4,462 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting picks/parlay/analytics routers into modules (e.g., backend/routes/picks.py, backend/routes/parlay.py). Not blocking, but each new carve-out makes the picks_today handler harder to reason about.

The mlb_hitter_q regex matches '\bhits?\b' which is correctly de-conflicted from pitcher markets via the $nor on 'strikeout|outs recorded'. Verified empirically: 3 pitcher Ks surfaced via mlb_k_q, no double-counting. Logic is sound.

Carve-out edge tolerance of -3% on hitter alt-locks is justified by the chalk-pricing reality (Over 0.5 Hits ~ -350 implies ~78% with sharp books often 1-3% over true). Three of the surfaced hitters are mildly -EV (Casey Schmitt -1.5%, Joey Meneses -0.9%, Tatis Jr. -2.2%). Recommend exposing edge_percent prominently in the UI so chalky alt-locks are not mistaken for value bets.

rca_of_issue: Original RCA: MLB Hits/HR/RBI/H+R+RBI/TB alt-LOCK props are priced ~-1500 (~94% implied) by sportsbooks. The standard lock_score formula penalizes chalky alt-locks down to 55-61, well below the global 80 floor, so they never surfaced — leading to the user's 'where are the hitters' complaint. Fix introduces `mlb_hitter_q` as a parallel carve-out (lock>=70, edge>=-3%, hitter market regex, pitcher-market $nor exclusion) OR-ed into the global query. The user's min_lock slider remains authoritative via a global AND so explicit floors still hide carve-out picks. Verified by 14 assertions on the live public URL.
